title: Pewter City Gym Leader (Remix Hard Mode)
threat_analysis: In Remix Hard Mode, Brock shifts away from pure Rock/Ground attrition into a fortified Steel-type defensive bulwark. Lead Aron/Psyduck (Lv. 10) combines Steel and Water typing, resisting 10 types while threatening delayed damage via Future Sight and forcing switches with Yawn. His Ace, Steelix/Mime Jr. (Lv. 14), is a Steel/Fairy fortress with Filter, softening super-effective hits. Carrying Gyro Ball and Confusion backed by Barrier and an Oran Berry, it walls unprepared physical attackers.
tactical_counter_plan: Bulbasaur Team Strategy: Bulbasaur's Leech Seed bypasses Filter and drains Steelix/Mime Jr. through Barrier. Pair Bulbasaur with Route 22 Phanpy (Ground) — Rollout and Ground pressure exploit both opponents' shared Ground weakness.

Charmander Team Strategy: Charmander's Ember hits Steelix/Mime Jr. for super-effective Fire damage. Pair with Secret Garden Riolu (Fighting), whose Counter and Quick Attack deal super-effective damage to Aron/Psyduck.

Squirtle Team Strategy: Squirtle's Water Gun hits Aron/Psyduck neutrally and tanks hits with Withdraw. Pair with Route 22 Slugma (Fire/Rock), whose Ember incinerates Steelix/Mime Jr., while Rock Throw provides solid neutral power.

Countering Yawn and Barrier: When Aron/Psyduck uses Yawn, capitalize on the turn to set status before switching, or burst it down. Against Steelix, prioritize special attacks or Leech Seed to circumvent Barrier.
